Text: Sandboxing and Isolated Execution for Agents

Running agent code or tool calls in an untrusted environment can be dangerous. 

Sandboxing provides isolated execution environments so agents cannot access or damage the host system even if compromised.

This is becoming essential for safe agent execution.

As a dev, I now use sandboxing for agent tool execution.

Sandboxing Cheatsheet:

Run agent tools in isolated environments

Limit file system and network access
Use lightweight sandboxes (e.g., Firecracker, gVisor)

Monitor and log all sandbox activity

Automatically terminate suspicious behavior

Pro tip: Sandboxing significantly reduces the blast radius of compromised agents
